display.purpose: Brand wordmark, novel titles, act headers — Fraunces at hero scale.

headline.purpose: Page titles and large structural headings.

title.purpose: Chapter headings, sidebar section titles — Source Serif 4.

body.purpose: Scene prose in the editor — Source Serif 4 at 1.125rem / 1.75.

label.purpose: Controls, metadata, uppercase tracking — IBM Plex Sans.

shadows.name: hairline-rim
shadows.purpose: Implicit page edge separation in light mode; not card elevation.

shadows.name: hairline-rim-dark
shadows.purpose: Implicit page edge separation in dark mode.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for color and opacity transitions.

motion.name: panel-enter
motion.purpose: Soft rise on slash-command shells, rewrite review, and page panels.

motion.name: rise-keyframes
motion.purpose: panel-enter animation — weight in motion, never bounce.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call to action — Create, Save, Run, Apply.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; background: #2f5d50; color: #f3efe6; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #24352f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f5d50; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost bordered control for Settings, Export, Discard.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; background: transparent; color: #6b6358; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #d4cbb8; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: #1a1612; border-color: #6b6358; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f5d50; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard bordered field on parchment background.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; width: 100%; max-width: 320px; background: #f3efe6; color: #1a1612; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #d4cbb8; border-radius: 6px; outline: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b6358; } .ds-input:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #2f5d50; }

components.name: Segmented Nav
components.description: Overview / Write mode toggle in app header.
components.css: .ds-segment-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid #d4cbb8; border-radius: 6px; background: #ebe4d6; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-segment-nav__item { padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 4px; color: #6b6358; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-segment-nav__item:hover { color: #1a1612; } .ds-segment-nav__item--active { background: #d7e6e0; color: #2f5d50; }

components.name: App Header
components.description: Sticky chrome with monumental brand mark and utility controls.
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d4cbb8; background: color-mix(in oklab, #f3efe6 90%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-header__brand { font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #1a1612; text-decoration: none; } .ds-header__spacer { flex: 1; }

components.name: Ledger Sidebar
components.description: Knowledge or beats rail — bordered panel beside manuscript.
components.css: .ds-ledger-rail { width: 280px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-right: 1px solid #d4cbb8; background: color-mix(in oklab, #ebe4d6 70%, transparent); } .ds-ledger-rail__head { padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d4cbb8; } .ds-ledger-rail__title { font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 400; margin: 0 0 8px; color: #1a1612; } .ds-input--compact { max-width: none; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 4px 8px; }

components.name: Manuscript Prose
components.description: Scene editor body text — quiet serif column.
components.html: The door opened onto rain-washed cobbles, and she knew the letter had found her too late.
components.css: .ds-manuscript { font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.75; color: #1a1612; max-width: 65ch; } .ds-manuscript p { margin: 0 0 1em; }

components.name: Diff Highlight
components.description: AI rewrite review — new text highlighted, original struck below.
components.html: She turned toward the harbor.She walked to the docks.
components.css: .ds-diff { display: inline-block; } .ds-diff__new { background: color-mix(in oklab, #8b3a2a 18%, transparent); color: #1a1612; border-bottom: 1px solid #8b3a2a; cursor: pointer; } .ds-diff__original { display: block; font-size: 0.78em; color: #8a8278; margin-top: 0.15rem; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; }

narrative.overview:
Quillsmith looks like a calm editorial desk: warm parchment, charcoal ink, and ledger side rails that hold working notes while the manuscript column stays quiet. The interface is dense enough for planning and lore management, but the writing surface never competes with the prose. Chrome is craft tooling, not SaaS marketing.

Depth is mostly tonal — stepped surfaces and hairline borders — with subtle lift reserved for sticky header chrome. Motion is weighty and brief: soft fade/slide on panel reveals, never bounce or candy physics.
keyCharacteristics: Warm parchment backgrounds with muted teal-ink accents
Three-font stack: Fraunces (brand), Source Serif 4 (manuscript), IBM Plex Sans (controls)
Wide-rail Write layout: 280px knowledge / fluid manuscript / 260px beats
Bordered, modest-radius controls; accent used sparingly on primary actions and selection
Flat surfaces at rest; hairline shadows and backdrop blur only on elevated chrome
Revision diffs use rewrite/original semantic colors, not generic highlight yellow

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal ink appears on primary buttons, active toggles, and key links — not as page-wide fills or gradient washes. Its scarcity is the point.

rules.name: The Parchment Not Cream Rule
rules.body: Background warmth is editorial parchment (#f3efe6), not generic cream SaaS (#F4F1EA alone). Avoid drifting into terracotta/cream AI cliché pairings.

rules.name: The Manuscript Column Rule
rules.body: Long-form prose uses Source Serif 4 at 1.125rem. UI chrome and sidebars use IBM Plex Sans. Fraunces is for brand and structural headings only.

rules.name: The Monumental Mark Rule
rules.body: "Quillsmith" in app chrome uses font-display at text-2xl minimum in the header and text-5xl on the home hero — never reduced to a tiny logotype.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Panels are bordered ledger sheets, not elevated cards. No card soup in the writing surface.

rules.name: The Chrome Lift Rule
rules.body: Only sticky header and transient command shells may use backdrop blur or translucency. Everything else stays opaque and flat.

dos: Do use the three-font stack: Fraunces (display), Source Serif 4 (manuscript), IBM Plex Sans (UI).
Do keep the manuscript column quiet — prose flows without card wrappers per paragraph.
Do use teal accent on primary actions and selected states only.
Do use ledger side rails at 280px / 260px in Write mode.
Do animate panel reveals with soft rise (280ms ease), opacity + 6px translateY.
Do render Quillsmith at display scale in chrome.
donts: Don't use purple/indigo gradients, glassmorphism stacks, glow orbs, or 3D SaaS blobs.
Don't use Inter, Roboto, Arial, or system-ui as the display face.
Don't use rounded-full pill clusters for primary navigation.
Don't fill the writing surface with card grids or dashboard widgets.
Don't use warm cream + terracotta + generic sans — the anti-slop pairing called out in the aesthetic brief.
Don't add bounce or playful motion to panel transitions.
